estilo.texto: Colours, cover, box and game extras. The preview updates as you go.
estilo.tintaAyuda: The main colour goes on the corners and the date side; the second one on the details of cards without a photo.
estilo.tituloMazoAyuda: Shown on the cover and the box. For example: Ana and Leo.
estilo.dedicatoriaAyuda: Printed on the back of the cover. Up to {max} characters.
estilo.portadaAyuda: Tap a photo to put it on the cover and the box.
estilo.mecanicasAyuda: They don’t change the price. You can remove them.
estilo.cajaAyuda: The standard box is included. If you like, we’ll personalise it with one of your photos and the deck’s title.
estilo.cajaFotoAyuda: Unless you pick another, it’s the cover photo.
estilo.cajaError: We couldn’t open that photo. Try another one in JPG, PNG, HEIC or WEBP.
estilo.cajaBaja: This photo is a little small for the box ({ppp} ppi): it may look blurry when printed. A larger one would be better.
estilo.sinFotos: Once you add photos, you can choose the cover.
